Merge FAERS data from 2020-4 to create allyears datasets for Zoloft and control.
```{r allyears}

not_zoloft_allyears=bind_rows(not_zoloft_2020,not_zoloft_2021,not_zoloft_2022,not_zoloft_2023,not_zoloft_2024)

not_zoloft_allyears=remove_duplicate_cases(not_zoloft_allyears)[[1]]

zoloft_allyears=bind_rows(zoloft_2020,zoloft_2021,zoloft_2022,zoloft_2023,zoloft_2024)
zoloft_allyears=remove_duplicate_cases(zoloft_allyears)[[1]]

#fix entry error in unified dataset
zoloft_allyears$sex[zoloft_allyears$sex=="UNK"]=""
```

Split allyears datasets to create new yearly datasets. Splitting datasets this way is a more efficient method of removing duplicates and correctly sorting data.

```{r new yearly}
zoloft_2020_new=zoloft_allyears %>% filter(between(fda_dt, as.Date("2020-1-1"),as.Date("2020-12-31")))
zoloft_2021_new=zoloft_allyears %>% filter(between(fda_dt, as.Date("2021-1-1"),as.Date("2021-12-31")))
zoloft_2022_new=zoloft_allyears %>% filter(between(fda_dt, as.Date("2022-1-1"),as.Date("2022-12-31")))
zoloft_2023_new=zoloft_allyears %>% filter(between(fda_dt, as.Date("2023-1-1"),as.Date("2023-12-31")))
zoloft_2024_new=zoloft_allyears %>% filter(between(fda_dt, as.Date("2024-1-1"),as.Date("2024-12-31")))

not_zoloft_2020_new=not_zoloft_allyears %>% filter(between(fda_dt, as.Date("2020-1-1"),as.Date("2020-12-31")))
not_zoloft_2021_new=not_zoloft_allyears %>% filter(between(fda_dt, as.Date("2021-1-1"),as.Date("2021-12-31")))
not_zoloft_2022_new=not_zoloft_allyears %>% filter(between(fda_dt, as.Date("2022-1-1"),as.Date("2022-12-31")))
not_zoloft_2023_new=not_zoloft_allyears %>% filter(between(fda_dt, as.Date("2023-1-1"),as.Date("2023-12-31")))
not_zoloft_2024_new=not_zoloft_allyears %>% filter(between(fda_dt, as.Date("2024-1-1"),as.Date("2024-12-31")))
```
Creation of data sets separated by unique patient. This allows us to determine the number of indiviudals who reported symptoms.
```{r unique}
zoloft_allyears_unique=distinct(zoloft_allyears, primaryid, .keep_all = TRUE)
not_zoloft_allyears_unique=distinct(not_zoloft_allyears, primaryid, .keep_all = TRUE)

```
Run PRR and ROR calculation are run on the allyears dataset and the qualifying ADRs are counted, restricted by case number and unrestricted for sensitivity analysis. 
```{r count}

PRR_allyears_not_zoloft_restricted=as.data.frame(prr_wrapper(zoloft_allyears, not_zoloft_allyears, 3)[1:4])
PRR_allyears_not_zoloft_unrestricted=as.data.frame(prr_wrapper(zoloft_allyears, not_zoloft_allyears, 3)[5:8])

ROR_allyears_not_zoloft_restricted=as.data.frame(ror_wrapper(zoloft_allyears, not_zoloft_allyears, 3)[1:4])
ROR_allyears_not_zoloft_unrestricted=as.data.frame(ror_wrapper(zoloft_allyears, not_zoloft_allyears, 3)[5:8])

ADRs_allyears_restricted=count_qualifying_ADRs(PRR_dataset = PRR_allyears_not_zoloft_restricted, ROR_dataset = ROR_allyears_not_zoloft_restricted)


ADRs_allyears_unrestricted=count_qualifying_ADRs(PRR_dataset = PRR_allyears_not_zoloft_unrestricted, ROR_dataset = ROR_allyears_not_zoloft_unrestricted)

```
ADR rate calculation for Zoloft pooled data.
```{r adrrate}
all_years_adr_rate=adr_rate(zoloft_allyears)

```


Counting indications for pooled Zoloft and control groups.
```{r zoloft indication, echo=FALSE}

zoloft_indi_all_final=count_indications (c("Anxiety", "Depression", "Panic", "Post-traumatic", "Obsessive-compulsive", "Premenstrual "),zoloft_allyears)
print(zoloft_indi_all_final)

```

```{r control indication, echo=FALSE}

not_zoloft_indi_all=as.data.frame(table(not_zoloft_allyears$indi_pt_all))
not_zoloft_indi_final=count_indications (c("Anxiety", "Depression", "Panic", "Post-traumatic", "Obsessive-compulsive", "Premenstrual "),not_zoloft_allyears)
print(not_zoloft_indi_final)
```
Yearly analysis, beginning with 2020.
```{r 2020}
#create new dataset for unique patients 
zoloft_unique_2020=distinct(zoloft_2020_new, primaryid, .keep_all = TRUE)
not_zoloft_unique_2020=distinct(not_zoloft_2020_new, primaryid, .keep_all = TRUE)

```

```{r prr ror 2020}
#calculate prr/ror with limitations on number of cases against no limitations
ip_2020_restricted=as.data.frame(prr_wrapper(zoloft_2020, not_zoloft_2020, 3)[1:4])
ip_2020_unrestricted=as.data.frame(prr_wrapper(zoloft_2020, not_zoloft_2020, 3)[5:8])

ic_2020_restricted=as.data.frame(ror_wrapper(zoloft_2020, not_zoloft_2020, 3)[1:4])
ic_2020_unrestricted=as.data.frame(ror_wrapper(zoloft_2020, not_zoloft_2020, 3)[5:8])

#count qualifying adrs for both cases
qualifying_adrs_2020_restricted=count_qualifying_ADRs(PRR_dataset = ip_2020_restricted, ROR_dataset = ic_2020_restricted)


qualifying_adrs_2020_unrestricted=count_qualifying_ADRs(PRR_dataset = ip_2020_unrestricted, ROR_dataset = ic_2020_unrestricted)
```




Chisquared for cleaning method 1
```{r chisq 1}

print("Indication Chisquared test by case")
set.seed(1)
c_table_ind2=matrix(rbind(zoloft_indi_all_final,not_zoloft_indi_final)$by_case,ncol=6,byrow=TRUE)
chisq.test(c_table_ind2,simulate.p.value=TRUE)

print("Indication Chisquared test by patient")
c_table_ind2=matrix(rbind(zoloft_indi_all_final,not_zoloft_indi_final)$count,ncol=6,byrow=TRUE)
chisq.test(c_table_ind2,simulate.p.value=TRUE)

#chisquared sex

print("Sex Chisquared test")

c_table_ind2=matrix(as.data.frame(rbind(d_table_z_all[1:3,], d_table_c_all[1:3,]))$Count,ncol=2)
chisq.test(c_table_ind2)

#chisquared weight
print("Weight Chisquared test")
c_table_ind2=matrix(as.data.frame(rbind(d_table_z_all[5:7,], d_table_c_all[5:7,]))$Count,ncol=2)
chisq.test(c_table_ind2,simulate.p.value=FALSE)

#chisquared age
print("Age Chisquared test")
c_table_ind2=matrix(as.data.frame(rbind(d_table_z_all[8:11,], d_table_c_all[8:11,]))$Count,ncol=2)
chisq.test(c_table_ind2)

```

Prepare the Venn Diagram


```{r VD}


data1=lapply(qualifying_adrs_2024_restricted$ADRs, as.character)
data2=lapply(qualifying_adrs_2023_restricted$ADRs, as.character)
data3=lapply(qualifying_adrs_2022_restricted$ADRs, as.character)
data4=lapply(qualifying_adrs_2021_restricted$ADRs, as.character)
data5=lapply(qualifying_adrs_2020_restricted$ADRs, as.character)
overlap_adrs=venn.diagram(x=list(data1,data2,data3,data4,data5),
             category.names = c("2024","2023","2022","2021","2020"),
             filename = NULL, 
             col=c("#440154ff", '#21908dff', '#fde725ff', '#F54927','#55E678'),
             fill = c(alpha("#440154ff",0.3), alpha('#21908dff',0.3), alpha('#fde725ff',0.3),alpha('#F54927',0.3),alpha('#55E678',0.3)),)
print(overlap_adrs)

```
Counting number of years ADRs occurred, both greater than 3 and any year at all.
```{r yearcounts}

qualifying_adrs_2020_restricted$year=2020
qualifying_adrs_2021_restricted$year=2021
qualifying_adrs_2023_restricted$year=2023
qualifying_adrs_2022_restricted$year=2022
qualifying_adrs_2024_restricted$year=2024
all_adrs=rbind(qualifying_adrs_2020_restricted, qualifying_adrs_2021_restricted,qualifying_adrs_2023_restricted,qualifying_adrs_2022_restricted, qualifying_adrs_2024_restricted)

all_adrs=rbind(qualifying_adrs_2020_restricted, qualifying_adrs_2021_restricted,qualifying_adrs_2023_restricted,qualifying_adrs_2022_restricted, qualifying_adrs_2024_restricted)
year_counts3_restricted <- all_adrs %>%
  group_by(ADRs) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(year_count = n_distinct(year)) %>%
  filter(year_count >= 3)
year_counts0_restricted <- all_adrs %>%
  group_by(ADRs) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(year_count = n_distinct(year)) %>%
  filter(year_count >= 0)

```

Counting number of years ADRs occurred, both greater than 3 and any year at all without restricting the number of cases.
```{r yearcounts unrestricted}

qualifying_adrs_2020_unrestricted$year=2020
qualifying_adrs_2021_unrestricted$year=2021
qualifying_adrs_2023_unrestricted$year=2023
qualifying_adrs_2022_unrestricted$year=2022
qualifying_adrs_2024_unrestricted$year=2024
all_adrs=rbind(qualifying_adrs_2020_unrestricted, qualifying_adrs_2021_unrestricted,qualifying_adrs_2023_unrestricted,qualifying_adrs_2022_unrestricted, qualifying_adrs_2024_restricted)

all_adrs=rbind(qualifying_adrs_2020_unrestricted, qualifying_adrs_2021_unrestricted,qualifying_adrs_2023_unrestricted,qualifying_adrs_2022_unrestricted, qualifying_adrs_2024_unrestricted)
year_counts3_unrestricted <- all_adrs %>%
  group_by(ADRs) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(year_count = n_distinct(year)) %>%
  filter(year_count >= 3)
year_counts0_unrestricted <- all_adrs %>%
  group_by(ADRs) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(year_count = n_distinct(year)) %>%
  filter(year_count >= 0)

```

```{r hist}
ggplot(year_counts0_restricted, aes(x = year_count)) + 
  geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "deepskyblue3", 
                 bins = 5)+labs(
                   title="Histogram of Significant ADRs",
                   x="Number of Years ADRs Occur",
                   y="Number of ADRs") +theme(panel.background=element_rect(fill="lightblue"))


```
Comparing overlap between ADRs discovered in pooled data vs yearly
```{r overlap}
overlap=merge(ADRs_allyears_restricted, year_counts0_restricted,by="ADRs",all=TRUE)
overlap$year_count[is.na(overlap$year_count)]=0
ggplot(overlap, aes(x = year_count)) + 
  geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "deepskyblue3", 
                 bins = 5)+labs(
                   title="Comparison of Yearly ADRs vs Pooled (0 years)",
                   x="Number of Years ADRs Occur",
                   y="Number of ADRs") +theme(panel.background=element_rect(fill="lightblue"))



```
